Messages.Body:
The card says that the vampire cannot cast any votes, does that mean he
cannot call them either? Since a political vote card always gives one
vote, or does it mean that the vampire can call the vote but doesn't
gain the 1 vote the card gives?

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Mark & Kathy ShaneWood wrote:
> Michael F. Tomkins <m.to...@student.canberra.edu.au> wrote:
> > LSJ <vte...@white-wolf.com> wrote:
> > > Votes from a Political Action card is cast only by the Methuselah -
> > > it is not considered to be cast by the vampire playing it (if any).
> >
> > Ok, so the vote card is from the Methuselah, what about Charming Lobby,
> > States gain 2 Votes at Superior?
> >
> That's the rub of Detection. Most Action Modifiers state "gain X votes" -
> the minion playing the AM would gain them, and a Detected Lasombra can
> _gain_ them, but can't cast them. So he sits there with his stack of votes
> and abstains.

Correct (although Charming Lobby is not an Action Modifier).
The votes from the card come from the vampire. See the clarified
card text online:

+1 stealth {political action. Call a referendum. If the referendum passes,
then the next referendum called} thereafter passes automatically. (S) As
above, and <this vampire gains> 2 votes for the first <referendum>.
